title: Courtnotes common definitions
description: Shared building blocks and controlled vocabularies for the Courtnotes court-watch data standard, version 1. Released under CC0 1.0.

schema_version.description: Version of the Courtnotes data standard the record conforms to. Minor versions only ever add optional fields or vocabulary terms, so any 1.x reader can read any 1.x record.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit offset, e.g. 2026-03-02T09:14:00-05:00 or 2026-03-02T14:14:00Z.

program.description: The court watch program that collected the record.

id.description: Stable, URL-safe identifier chosen by the program, e.g. `philly-bail-watch`.

observer.description: The volunteer who made the observation. Use a pseudonymous id; names are optional and should be stripped from public exports.

name.description: Courthouse or court name as it appears on the building or docket, e.g. `Criminal Justice Center`.

courtroom.description: Courtroom number or name, e.g. `1101` or `Arraignment Court B`.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code of the state or province, e.g. `US-PA`.

judge.description: The judicial officer presiding over the hearing. Judges are public officials acting in public; recording their names is the point of court watching.

name.description: Name as announced in court or shown on the courtroom door, e.g. `Hon. A. Marlowe`.

oneOf.title: Arraignment
oneOf.description: First appearance where charges are read and pretrial release is usually decided.

oneOf.title: Bail review
oneOf.description: Hearing to set, reconsider or modify bail or release conditions.

oneOf.title: Preliminary hearing
oneOf.description: Hearing to decide whether there is enough evidence for the case to proceed.

oneOf.title: Status / scheduling
oneOf.description: Status check, calendar call or scheduling conference.

oneOf.title: Motion
oneOf.description: Argument on a motion, such as to suppress evidence or dismiss.

oneOf.title: Plea
oneOf.description: Change of plea or plea agreement colloquy.

oneOf.title: Sentencing
oneOf.description: Imposition of sentence after conviction or plea.

oneOf.title: Trial
oneOf.description: Any portion of a bench or jury trial.

oneOf.title: Probation violation
oneOf.description: Violation-of-probation or parole hearing.

oneOf.title: Other
oneOf.description: Anything else; describe it in notes.

counsel.description: Who represented the defendant at this hearing.

oneOf.title: Public defender
oneOf.description: Staff attorney from a public defender office.

oneOf.title: Court-appointed
oneOf.description: Private attorney appointed and paid by the court.

oneOf.title: Private
oneOf.description: Retained private attorney.

oneOf.title: No lawyer
oneOf.description: Defendant appeared without any lawyer.

oneOf.title: Waived / pro se
oneOf.description: Defendant waived counsel and represented themselves.

oneOf.title: Couldn't tell
oneOf.description: The observer could not determine representation.

outcome.description: What happened to the case at the end of the hearing.

oneOf.title: Continued
oneOf.description: Postponed or rescheduled to another date.

oneOf.title: Dismissed / withdrawn
oneOf.description: Charges dismissed, withdrawn or nolle prossed.

oneOf.title: Held for trial
oneOf.description: Bound over or held for court on some or all charges.

oneOf.title: Plea entered
oneOf.description: Guilty or no-contest plea accepted.

oneOf.title: Sentenced
oneOf.description: A sentence was imposed.

oneOf.title: Diversion
oneOf.description: Sent to a diversion, treatment or problem-solving court program.

oneOf.title: Warrant issued
oneOf.description: Bench warrant issued, usually for a missed appearance.

oneOf.title: Other
oneOf.description: Anything else; describe it in notes.

release_decision.description: The pretrial release decision made at this hearing, if any.

oneOf.title: Released (ROR)
oneOf.description: Released on own recognizance with no money bail.

oneOf.title: Released w/ conditions
oneOf.description: Released without money bail but with non-monetary conditions.

oneOf.title: Bail set
oneOf.description: Money bail was set. Record the amount in `bail`.

oneOf.title: Held, no bail
oneOf.description: Detained with no possibility of release on bail.

oneOf.title: Stays in custody
oneOf.description: Remains detained for another reason, such as a detainer or existing sentence.

oneOf.title: Not addressed
oneOf.description: Release was not discussed at this hearing.

bail_type.description: How the money bail must be posted.

oneOf.title: Cash
oneOf.description: Full amount payable in cash.

oneOf.title: Secured / surety
oneOf.description: Secured by property or a bail bond agent.

oneOf.title: 10% deposit
oneOf.description: A percentage (often 10%) is payable to the court.

oneOf.title: Unsecured
oneOf.description: Nothing paid up front; owed only on non-appearance.

oneOf.title: Other
oneOf.description: Anything else; describe it in notes.

interpreter.description: Whether an interpreter was needed and provided.

perceived_gender.description: Gender as perceived by the observer. Never ask the defendant.

perceived_race_ethnicity.description: Race or ethnicity as perceived by the observer, used only for aggregate disparity analysis. Never ask the defendant.

perceived_age_range.description: Age range as perceived by the observer.

extensions.description: Program-specific fields that are not part of the standard. Keys must be namespaced with the program id, e.g. `philly-bail-watch:docket_type`, so they never collide with future standard fields.
